canonical_definition:
What it is. Papers describe MME-P as a multimodal benchmark for visual understanding, with one definition specifying OCR and fine-grained visual reasoning as prominent task types. A second description treats MME Perception as a sub-benchmark of the MME suite for evaluating visual perception capabilities, and one paper explicitly inspects OCR-related tasks within MME-P.

What it is claimed to measure. Across the reported relationships, papers use it to measure Visual understanding, and this is the only construct linked to it. No behavioral indicators are linked to it, so the reported measurement claims concentrate on a single construct rather than spreading across multiple outcomes.

Space of uses. No other measurement instruments are linked to it. In use, one paper includes MME Perception among several mainstream benchmarks in a broader evaluation suite, while another reports an overall MME-P score under visual understanding benchmarking and then examines OCR-related tasks within the benchmark.
